title: Professional Services Projects Signature Validity and Kickoff Conditions
content:
This clause of Professional Services Projects governs when a statement of work may be signed, how the deposit invoice stood at signature, and when a project may kick off.

## Signature within the validity period

A statement of work may be signed only within the class's validity period (the calendar days after issue within which it may be signed at its quoted price) after it was issued. The validity period is counted in calendar days from the issue date, that date being day 0, and a signature on the last day is in time.

- Clock start: the issue date of the statement of work, as the engagement record shows it.
- Counting: calendar days, the issue date itself being day 0.
- Comparison: the signature date must be no later than the last day of the period; the last day itself is in time.
- Evidence: the system record of the engagement and its issue date.

| Hypothetical case, 30-day validity period | Signature |
|---|---|
| Signed on day 30 after the issue date | in time |
| Signed on day 31 after the issue date | not in time |

## Deposit at signature

The former clause under which, on signature, the deposit was invoiced at the class deposit percentage of the original contract value, rounded half up to the cent, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for the deposit invoice.

## Business days

Business days are Monday through Friday excluding the observed company holidays of the class.

## Kickoff

A project may kick off only after the deposit invoice is paid in full, no earlier than the class's kickoff lead time in business days after the day the deposit payment posted, and no earlier than the scheduled start date. Kickoff happens on the later of those dates.

| Deposit invoice paid in full? | Lead time in business days after the deposit payment posted reached? | Scheduled start date reached? | Kickoff |
|---|---|---|---|
| No | any | any | may not happen |
| Yes | No | any | may not happen |
| Yes | Yes | No | may not happen |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | may happen |

The evidence is the system record of the engagement's billing: the deposit invoice, its amount and the payments posted against it.

Hypothetical illustration: where the deposit payment posts on a day D and the date that is the class's lead time in business days after D falls before the scheduled start date, kickoff is on the scheduled start date; where that date falls after the scheduled start date, kickoff is on that date.

superseded_clauses: On signature the deposit is invoiced: deposit_pct percent of original_value_usd, rounded half up to the cent.
